# Decisions: linked-context

- 2026-09-29T10:07:56.125Z — (superseded by D5) chose **No sub-initiative hierarchy. Records group and depend on each other through typed links at task grain (waits_on declared, cites derived); an umbrella is an initiative whose tasks link to its members.** over Parent/child sub-initiatives (beads-style parent-child edge) because Real dependencies are task→task/decision across records and a record often depends on several others; a tree allows one parent and says only 'belongs together', which a link already says. Phases already split work inside a record and supersession covers replacement. Proposed to the operator 2026-09-29; revisit if they rule otherwise.
- 2026-09-29T10:08:02.037Z — rule: **Never read the reach index or buildGraph from a hook, statusline or shim path for travel; read only the links tier.** — chose **Travel reads a write-time materialised hot tier, index-tier1 links/<slug>.json (neighbours pattern, cursor-incremental, target staleness by tail read), never the reach index or buildGraph** over Reading reach.json from SessionStart as the 2026-09-20 skeleton said, or folding neighbour logs at session start because The reach code is banned from hook bundles by graph-hotpath.test.ts (record-index 4.1) and record-graph D2 rejected N-log reads on the hot path; reach is refreshed only by sofar find and Rust has no reader. A narrow tier costs O(links) per read, predicted ≤0.5ms Rust.
- 2026-09-29T10:08:04.482Z — chose **Memory handles in the link grammar are qualified-only (<slug> M<n>); repo.md lines stay unnumbered and out of the graph** over Bare M<n> and minting repo.md line nodes, as the roadmap-h2 note 01M2ZDKDRACY87BA26VWN825VP proposed because repo-memory-capture D3 deferred memory nodes until a disambiguation rule exists and named qualified-only as the likely one; M<n> is per-initiative so a bare handle is ambiguous, and repo.md is hand-written with no ids (repo-memory-capture D1).
- 2026-09-29T10:08:07.307Z — chose **Readiness-gated travel: open waits_on targets and waits resolved since the block are asserted; derived cites are offered only in the remaining budget, focus-ranked with hub damping; zero bytes when nothing is open** over Rendering every linked target (all-links travel) or ranking by raw citation count or recency because record-index D2: declared relevance may be asserted, derived only offered. The common case costs 0 tokens and an open wait ~40-60; raw counts let hub records dominate (record-index D9). Graphiti/Letta/aider precedents: validity filter, fixed block budgets, damped ranking. Predictions and ablations in Phase 6.
